relationshipReview.rationale: The coordinator independently reviewed the 74 source-selected Shadow King originals, corrected the mistaken Nightcrawler volume to 2014, and examined all eleven shared-ID sets in the complete 185-order source-library report. The shared comics are required by the Shadow King cuts and remain in their source positions. Other guides cover distinct events, characters or broader X-Men routes; none is an exact or subset duplicate. The remaining comparisons have verified empty shared-ID sets.
